description: This file manages Wi-Fi mesh topology visualization and control, including fetching topology data, rendering graphs, handling user interactions for node steering, hostname configuration, and band control commands.

methods.name: page_initial
methods.description: Initializes the page and loads topology data.

methods.name: mesh_topo_result
methods.description: Processes topology data and updates the graph and table views.

methods.name: set_mesh_topology_table
methods.description: Updates topology tables with mesh nodes and device nodes.

methods.name: get_topo_success_cb
methods.description: Callback for successful topology data retrieval.

methods.name: init_trigger_error_cb
methods.description: Handles API errors, including session timeout.

methods.name: close_map_topology
methods.description: Switches view back to table topology.

methods.name: get_hostname_success_cb
methods.description: Updates hostname list after successful fetch.

methods.name: show_graph
methods.description: Loads and displays the topology graph.

methods.name: topology_show
methods.description: Controls visibility of topology graph or table.

methods.name: getDefineHostname
methods.description: Retrieves hostname for a given MAC address.

methods.name: node_control
methods.description: Handles node control actions, including showing control UI.

methods.name: _node_control
methods.description: Internal function to display node control dialog and options.

methods.name: bh_band_control
methods.description: Controls band steering for a device.

methods.name: sta_band_control
methods.description: Controls band steering for a client.

methods.name: set_info_data
methods.description: Sends configuration data to backend API.
